verdicts.reason: Both get the reading order wrong. The 'Find a Store' CTA sits at the very top above the headline, and the SOLSTICE wordmark is wedged between the headline and the body copy, so the logo works like a subhead. The can is pushed down to the bottom with empty space on both sides. B is the more cramped of the two: its CTA almost touches the top edge, the headline, logo and body copy are stacked tightly, and the can is smaller. A has slightly more breathing room and a larger product, but it still has the same broken hierarchy and the same cluster at the top above a lot of dead space.
